briefdescription.para: Memory cell mem contains the context of an aggregate function.

detaileddescription.para: This routine calls the finalize method for that function. The result of the aggregate is stored back into mem.
Returns -1 if the finalizer reports an error. 0 otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Convert mem to NUMBER type, so that after conversion it has one of types MEM_Real, MEM_Int or MEM_UInt.

detaileddescription.para: If conversion is not possible, function returns -1.
Beware - this function changes value and type of mem argument.

briefdescription.para: According to ANSI SQL string value can be converted to boolean type if string consists of literal "true" or "false" and number of leading and trailing spaces.

detaileddescription.para: For instance, " tRuE " can be successfully converted to boolean value true.

parameterdescription.para: String to be converted to boolean. Assumed to be null terminated.
